- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The UN Global Counter-Terrorism Strategy was adopted in 2006, aiming to prevent and combat terrorism by addressing conditions that promote its spread and ensuring respect for human rights.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The UN General Assembly can refer cases of aggression and terrorism to the UN Security Council, which can impose sanctions and authorize the use of force.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The UN General Assembly has established specialized committees, including the Counter-Terrorism Committee (CTC) and the Al-Qaida Sanctions Committee.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The UN General Assembly provides technical assistance and capacity-building support to member states to help them prevent and counter terrorism.
